CONTRACT OF LEASE

This Contract of Lease is made and entered into by and between MARIA SANTOS, of legal age, Filipino, with residence at 45 Ilang-Ilang Street, Barangay Poblacion, Makati City (hereinafter referred to as the "Landlord"), and JUAN DELA CRUZ, of legal age, Filipino, with residence at 12 Sampaguita Street, Barangay San Isidro, Quezon City (hereinafter referred to as the "Tenant"), for the residential unit located at 78 Mabini Street, Barangay San Isidro, Quezon City.

1. TERM. This lease shall be for a period of one (1) year, commencing on January 1, 2027 and ending on December 31, 2027.

2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay the Landlord a monthly rent of Php 15,000.00, payable in advance on or before the fifth day of each month.

3. ADVANCE RENT. The Tenant shall pay six (6) months advance rent prior to move-in.

4. LATE PAYMENT PENALTY. Any unpaid rent shall be subject to a penalty of 2% per day until fully settled.

5. RENT ADJUSTMENT. Annually, the monthly rent shall be adjusted to the prevailing market rate as determined by the Landlord.

6. SECURITY DEPOSIT. The security deposit may be applied by the Landlord against any claim without need for an itemized statement.

7. TERMINATION. Any violation of this Contract by the Tenant, however minor, shall be sufficient ground for the Landlord to terminate this lease immediately, without prior written notice.

8. REPAIRS AND MAINTENANCE. The Tenant shall be responsible for minor repairs; the Landlord shall be responsible for major structural repairs and maintenance.

9. DEFAULT AND EVICTION. In the event of default, the Landlord may enter the leased premises, change the locks, and remove the Tenant's belongings without a court order.

10. SUBLETTING. The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or transfer any interest in this lease under any circumstance.

11. GOVERNING LAW. This Contract shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this Contract on this 15th day of December, 2026, in Quezon City, Philippines.

_________________________          _________________________
MARIA SANTOS (Landlord)             JUAN DELA CRUZ (Tenant)
